title: YouTube Video
html:
A video platform with 2B users, 500 hours of video uploaded per minute. Core challenges: video transcoding at scale, global video delivery.

Requirements

Functional

Upload videos · Stream videos at multiple resolutions · Search · Subscribe and recommended feed · Like/comment

Non-Functional

2B MAU · 500hrs video/min uploaded · Read-heavy (100:1) · Smooth streaming globally · Video must never be lost

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming

Video is split into small chunks (2-10 seconds). Each chunk is encoded at multiple bitrates. The player downloads a manifest file listing all available qualities and dynamically selects chunks based on current bandwidth. This is HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) or DASH. Why it matters: smooth playback even on variable connections.
